findings.F1_h2_arithmetic: CONFIRMED — recomputed independently: FY25 rev 2,524.7 (Q 568.5/586.6/635.9/733.7; organic -1.8/+0.7/+2.9/+0.5 verbatim from the FY25 PR table), H1-26 organic +0.8% on 1,155.1 base. FY26 at 2.0% requires H2 organic 3.01%; a passing Q3 at exactly 2.0% forces Q4 to 3.89% — the best quarter in 2025-26 was +3.0% (Q2-26), so the guide-consistent path needs back-to-back near-record quarters against the hardest comp (Q3-25 +2.9%; ~5.9% two-yr stack at guide rate). STRENGTHENER red missed: Ipsos' own order-book metric for 2026-recognized revenue grew only 1.6% at end-June — roughly HALF the required H2 run-rate. Honest counterweights (asymmetric-error): 'around 2%' has fuzz (FY 1.8% needs only H2 ~2.6%); Q4-25 comp is easy (+0.5%); the order book is accelerating (1.0->1.6%) and March order-intake timing flows into H2.

blue_adjudication_20260731.final_verdict: WATCH 5/10, paper-track, event-gated (was STARTER 6/10). The court's tranche architecture SURVIVES — but as a POST-EVENT re-entry template, not a pre-event deployment. Red Q2 resolved: DEFER T1 past Sept-14 rather than pricing the binary into the band, because on the court's own weights any pre-event price above ~33-34 is negative-EV, and a pre-event fill AT <=33 into a 6-week information vacuum with decaying disclosure would almost certainly be adverse selection (the TEP second-leg shape). Re-entry rules: (a) B1 resolves YES per the pre-committed spec -> STARTER 0.5% NLV up to EUR38; T2 +0.5% gated on Q3 organic >=2.0% AND a QUANTIFIED Ipsos.Digital number >=15%; cap 1.5% NLV. (b) B1 NO via review/silence -> stay paper; re-court at the FY-guide event. (c) B1 NO via explicit downgrade/withdrawal -> governance kill trigger fires; interest resumes only as a NEW court if price reaches the honest floor zone (<=22). No-adds line REBUILT: 'no adds <31' becomes NO CAPITAL below 31 without a fresh court (structural-confirmation zone), with the honest tail floor ~20 as the sizing constraint.

B1.ruling: red directionally right — the court's 0.45 underweights the 'targets under review / update at FY' middle path, which the pre-committed spec resolves NO, and underweights the new-CEO reset incentive (Beaver arrives BECAUSE yr-1 ran below the band); the board's continuity mandate ('continue to implement the Horizons plan') is why blue is not lower.
B1.precommitted_spec: B1 resolves YES ONLY IF the first Beaver market communication (the Sept-14 address, or an earlier official release) EXPLICITLY reaffirms the quantified Horizons mid-term targets — average organic growth 3-4% over 2026-2028 AND operating margin 13.5% in 2028 (14%+ 2030) — with no downgrade, no suspension, and no review-pending status. 'Targets under review', 'we will update at FY results', silence on mid-term targets, reaffirming ONLY FY-2026 guidance, or replacement targets below the old levels ALL resolve NO. Replacement targets at-or-above the old levels resolve YES. If no Beaver market communication addressing mid-term targets occurs by 2026-10-31, B1 resolves NO (withdrawal-by-silence). Any residual ambiguity resolves NO: the event is 'reaffirm without downgrade or suspension' — absence of affirmation IS failure.

B2.ruling: red confirmed — the court's 0.65 leaned on the credibility of a guide that had just been cut; against the hardest comp (+2.9%) with the order book at 1.6%, coin-flip is honest. Counterweights keeping blue at 0.50 not lower: Q2 momentum +3.0%, order-book acceleration, March order-intake timing flowing into H2.
B2.precommitted_spec: B2 resolves from the quarterly organic-growth figure printed in the Q3-2026 revenue release (~late-Oct-2026): YES iff Q3-26 organic >= 2.0% exactly as printed (2.0% = YES).

B3.ruling: between, nearer red — a third revision within ~3 months is reputationally hard for an incumbent but ~free for a new CEO (kitchen-sink incentive at Sept-14 or the Q3 print); margin-guide maintenance and the accelerating order book argue against, hence 0.30 not 0.35.
B3.precommitted_spec: B3 resolves YES if ANY official Ipsos communication on or before the Q3-2026 revenue release states FY-2026 organic guidance below 2% ('slightly below 2%', '~1.5%', a range topping below 2%, or withdrawal of the FY guide). Retaining 'around 2%' language = NO. Doubles as the kill-trigger probability.

METRIC_INVALIDATION_20260818: *** METRIC INVALIDATED 2026-08-18 (OBDC blue bench) — READ BEFORE USING ANY 'IMPLIED MARK ON NON-ACCRUALS' FIGURE IN THIS RECORD. *** The cohort ladder I built and used all session — TCPC 19.4c / OTF 22.8c / OBDC 29.5c / PNNT 31.1c / FSK 47.9c / WHF 50.4c / MFIC 55.1c — DOES NOT MEASURE MARKING DISCIPLINE. Implied mark = non-accrual FV% / cost% is dominated by CONCENTRATION AND TIMING: it tells you WHEN a manager's worst credit blew up, not how honestly it marks. Ex-that-single-name OBDC computes at 38.7c rather than 29.5c. THE LADDER MUST BE RECOMPUTED EX-LARGEST-NAME BEFORE IT IS EVER USED TO ORDER MANAGERS AGAIN, and until then no verdict may rest on it.
